title: Glam Metal
lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Ignition]
Kick the door, the road’s alive
moonlight cutting through the drive.
I don’t chase what’s left behind
I burn it up and cross the line.

[Verse 2 – Momentum]
Rearview full of yesterday
radio loud to drown the grey.
Every light turns green for me
I’m movin’ faster than memory.

[Chorus – Hook]
Burnin’ rubber, feel it bite
steel and thunder in the night.
No one’s slowin’ me tonight—
burnin’ rubber, outta sight.

[Verse 3 – The Rush]
Wind cuts sharp, the world’s a spark
heartbeat hammer, trail of marks.
Every risk’s another flame
I play the fire, not the game.

[Bridge – Lift]
Headlights blur, the stars keep time
freedom hums along that line.
If it ends before I crash
I’ll go out loud in my own flash.

[Final Chorus / Outro]
Burnin’ rubber, can’t come down
engine screams that rebel sound.
No regrets, no lookin’ back—
burnin’ rubber, fade to black.

(guitar dive → long snare hit → fade)
